# Tim Bluthardt Portfolio

This website showcases interaction design and product design projects by Tim Bluthardt.

## Primary pages
- / : Home and project overview
- /aboutme : Biography and background
- /playground : Interactive experiments and prototypes
- /imprint : Legal information

## Content notes
- Project pages include images, videos, and descriptive captions.
- The site supports light and dark mode.
- Embedded views may append ?embed=1 for iframe usage.
